mainEntity.name: How should I compare AEO agencies in Mumbai?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between AEO services and SEO services?

mainEntity.name: Can AEO services help a business appear in Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO services can improve a page’s readiness by strengthening content usefulness, technical accessibility, structure, evidence and entity clarity. However, no agency can guarantee selection because Google decides when AI Overviews appear and which sources are included.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AEO campaign take to show results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary according to website authority, technical condition, indexing, competition, content quality and the scale of implementation. Some page improvements may be reflected after recrawling, while meaningful growth in rankings, answer visibility and leads usually requires ongoing work and measurement.

Both work best together because AI visibility still depends on crawlable content, authority, relevance, and trust.

mainEntity.name: How can a brand get cited in AI answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: A brand can improve its chances of being cited in AI answers by creating clear service pages, building topical authority, using structured data, maintaining consistent entity information, publishing credible resources, and earning trustworthy mentions across the web. No agency can guarantee AI citations, but the right structure improves eligibility.

mainEntity.name: Can LLM SEO work with AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LLM SEO works best when combined with AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO. SEO improves crawlability and search authority, AEO improves answer extraction, GEO improves generative search visibility, and LLM SEO helps AI systems interpret and recommend the brand more accurately.

mainEntity.name: Does LLM SEO improve ROI?

acceptedAnswer.text: LLM SEO can support ROI by improving brand visibility during high-intent research journeys where users ask AI tools for vendor recommendations, comparisons, and explanations. The impact depends on industry competition, authority signals, content quality, and how well the website supports conversion after discovery.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect from professional SEO services in Mumbai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional SEO services in Mumbai should include a technical audit, keyword and search-intent mapping, service-page optimization, local SEO, content improvements, authority building, conversion tracking, and clear reporting. The strategy should reflect your industry, target areas, competition, and business goals rather than relying on a fixed package.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide affordable local SEO services for small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DGS creates practical local SEO plans based on the website's current condition, target locations, and competition. Affordable local SEO services may include Google Business Profile optimization, local pages, citation improvement, technical fixes, review signals, and lead tracking without compromising essential work.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer AI SEO services and SEO services outside Mumbai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DGS supports AEO for direct-answer visibility, GEO for source and citation readiness in generative search, and LLM SEO for clearer brand and service understanding across AI systems. We also provide SEO services in India for businesses targeting multiple cities, national customers, or location-specific markets outside Mumbai.

mainEntity.name: How much do SEO services in Mumbai cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO pricing depends on website size, competition, target pages, technical issues, content needs, local visibility goals, and monthly scope. A proper audit helps determine the most practical plan.

mainEntity.name: How long does SEO take to show results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some technical and local improvements can show early movement, but strong results usually need consistent work. Timelines depend on competition, website condition, content quality, authority, and how often Google recrawls your pages.

mainEntity.name: Can you help if my pages are not getting indexed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We check noindex tags, blocked pages, sitemap problems, canonical conflicts, duplicate URLs, thin content, redirect chains, broken links, and Search Console coverage issues.

mainEntity.name: Can SEO help my business get more local enquiries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Local visibility can improve when your website, Google Business Profile, reviews, citations, service pages, and location signals are aligned properly.

mainEntity.name: Why is my website not ranking after adding content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Content alone may not be enough. The issue may involve technical errors, weak page structure, poor keyword intent, low authority, slow pages, duplicate content, or stronger competitors.

mainEntity.name: What makes DGS different from generic SEO providers?

acceptedAnswer.text: DGS focuses on clear strategy, technical depth, useful content, local visibility, simple reporting, and lead quality. The work stays connected to calls, forms, WhatsApp enquiries, qualified leads, and measurable business outcomes.

mainEntity.name: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

acceptedAnswer.text: No serious SEO team should guarantee rankings because Google results depend on many factors. DGS provides honest work, clear reporting, practical strategy, and consistent improvement efforts.
